entry.title: Why Optimizing Your Lighthouse Score Is Not Enough For A Fast Website
entry.summary: Feeling good with your Lighthouse score of 100%? You should! But you should also know that you’re only looking at part of the performance picture. Learn how Lighthouse scores are measured differently than other tools, the impact that has on measuring performance metrics, and why you need real-user monitoring for a complete picture.
